This matters for the bulk-update sibling: latest_result_id is guaranteed present and stable for untested rows too, so it can address every row unconditionally without a 'does this row even have a result yet' branch — but the sibling cannot use result-id-nullness to detect never-executed; it must key off latest_status instead.
